title: yamaa 1.0 analysis_results file
description: One file of the 1.0 analysis_results type. Each field carries its kind as x-yamaa-kind and its schema-notation type as x-yamaa-type. Generated from yaml/ by tools/packaging/generate_json_schema.py.

analysis_comment.description: Text, or text with the documents it refers to.

text.description: Text of the comment or documentation.

documents.description: Supporting documents the text refers to.

where.description: Output columns of the dataset and the values that select the records the result reads; a record is selected when every listed column meets its condition (DEFINE-32, SUB-12).

variables.description: Output columns of the dataset the result analyses; a result names at least one across its datasets (DEFINE-32).

analysis_purpose.description: Purpose of an analysis, one of the published values (DEFINE-31).

analysis_reason.description: Reason for an analysis, one of the published values (DEFINE-31).

id.description: Identifier of the result, unique within its display, closing the result's generated identity (DEFINE-9, DEFINE-32).

oid.description: arm:AnalysisResult OID written as declared, such as a received document's; omitted, the result's OID is AR.<display id>.<id> (DEFINE-9).

purpose.description: What the analysis is for in the study's objectives (DEFINE-31).

datasets.description: Datasets the result reads, at least one, each a dataset the section composes, in the order written (DEFINE-32).

join.description: How the result's datasets are joined, required when it reads two or more and refused when it reads one (DEFINE-32).

documentation.description: Documentation of the analysis, as text or text with the documents it refers to (DEFINE-31).

programming_code.description: Programming code that produced the result, as text, as documents holding it, or both (DEFINE-31).

analysis_result_oid.description: arm:AnalysisResult OID written as declared, the AR. prefix and printable ASCII that may hold spaces but does not end in one (DEFINE-9).

yamaa.description: Oldest language version this analysis results file needs, always quoted (SCHEMA-2).

type.description: File type of an analysis results file, which holds the result displays of one source (DEFINE-32).

encoding.description: Text encoding of this file's own bytes; omitted, the file is ASCII, and `utf-8` admits literal non-ASCII text in this file alone (SPEC-8).

displays.description: Result displays this source declares, at least one, in the order the document presents them (DEFINE-32).

analysis_text.description: Text of a join comment or of documentation, written plainly.

define_id.description: Identifier a generated OID is built from.

document_reference.description: Document identifier, or an identifier with the place it points at.

pages.description: Place within the document the reference points at.

file_encoding.description: Text encoding of a file's own bytes, which `encoding` declares (SPEC-8).

identifier.description: Single-token identifier; the field's own description states which naming list it belongs to, such as a declared dataset, a declared column, a document or a function (SPEC-2).

language_version.description: Language version a file declares in `yamaa`, the oldest that admits every field it writes (SCHEMA-2).

type.description: Whether refs are physical page numbers or named destinations.

refs.description: Space-separated page numbers or destination names.

title.description: Label a reader sees in place of the raw reference.

context.description: Language and version the code is written in, required when code is declared (DEFINE-32).

code.description: The code itself, written exactly as declared; nothing in this language parses or executes it (DEFINE-31).

documents.description: Supporting documents holding the code; code, documents or both are declared (DEFINE-32).

id.description: Identifier the display's generated identity is built from, unique among the section's displays (DEFINE-9, DEFINE-32).

oid.description: arm:ResultDisplay OID written as declared, such as a received document's; omitted, the display's OID is RD.<id> (DEFINE-9).

name.description: Name the display has in the report, such as its table number, unique among the section's displays (DEFINE-32).

description.description: Description of what the display shows (DEFINE-31).

documents.description: Supporting documents holding the display, each with the place the display is at (DEFINE-31).

results.description: Analysis results the display shows, at least one, in the order the document presents them (DEFINE-32).

result_display_oid.description: arm:ResultDisplay OID written as declared, the RD. prefix and printable ASCII that may hold spaces but does not end in one (DEFINE-9).

comparator.description: Comparison of the listed values, NE for a column unequal to one value and NOTIN for a column equal to none of them, or LT, LE, GT or GE for a column that is not str and orders below, at most, above or at least one value (SUB-12).

where_condition.description: Values that select a row by its where column, which equals the one value or any of several, unless a comparator states another comparison (SUB-12).

where_value.description: One value a where clause selects rows by, written as text and converted to a non-str where column's type under an ordered comparator, or when an analysis where clause lists it (SUB-12, DEFINE-32).
